name: GhosttyEXTREME
description: Ghostty for macOS, rebuilt to watch AI coding agents work live. Claude Code, Codex and more in a vertical sidebar, a code editor that types in their edits as they happen, a live code map, a backend view (Cloudflare, Supabase, Vercel), Visual Fix, agent races and change review.

paragraphs: GhosttyEXTREME is a macOS terminal for developers who run several AI coding agents, like Claude Code and Codex, across several projects at once. It's a fork of Ghostty, the fast native terminal, that shows what every agent is doing, live: the code it's writing as it writes it, where it is in your project, what part of your backend it touches, and when it needs you. Agents share what they learn about each project, hand work to each other, and leave their changes in a review inbox you can undo from.
Everything Ghostty does still works, and your Ghostty config works as-is. This fork tracks official Ghostty releases and adds its features on top.
Unofficial fork. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Ghostty project.
features: Agent sidebar Live status for every agent in every tab Mission Control Every agent in every window on one screen Code editor Opens what the agent reads and animates its edits Code map Your project as a map of what the…
A vertical sidebar (⌃⌘S) lists every tab with its folder, git branch and uncommitted changes. Tabs can be pinned, colored and renamed, and hovering one shows a card with more detail.
Live status: working, waiting for permission, waiting for input, done or failed. Each
card shows the task, how long the agent has been at it and its last action.
Answer without switching: Allow and Deny right on the card, in Mission Control
